description:
🐢✨ Have you heard about the new addition of duplexes in the Turtle Creek neighborhood in Troy, Texas? 🏡 These brand-new, never lived in homes are ready to lease right now—and we’ve got a fantastic move-in special! Get half off your first full month of rent when you get approved and sign a lease today! 🏠
Located just minutes from Troy ISD schools, Troy City Park, and local fan favorites like Bird Creek Burger Co. and Megg’s Cafe, this neighborhood offers easy access to both small-town charm and nearby Temple and Belton amenities!
 
✨ Features you’ll love: 
• Granite countertops & stained concrete floors 
• Stainless steel appliances & garage door opener 
• Yard maintenance included 
• Spacious open living area, kitchen island & pantry 
• Double sink in the main bathroom 
• Spacious main bedroom closet!
 
With everything nearby, don’t miss out on making this stylish home yours! Check out the virtual tour or schedule a tour for 303A Juniper, today!: 
https://spradleyproperties.com/unit-detail/?id=2814&unit=303A%20Juniper%20Dr.
